normalisation.subject: R315 advertised1268 sqft original-condition3BR/2BA at700000;780000 furnished expression is a separate conditional package
normalisation.admissible_claim: Reported continued clearing across old family-capable projects, with material dispersion. No premium or absolute price floor is measured.
normalisation.high_price_treatment: The May2025 RM1m record is retained in the full observed range. It is unexplained, not assumed erroneous or a valid ordinary-condition premium. June2024 RM1m also retained as context. No trimmed range is called fair value.
normalisation.reason: 1268/1292 product mapping, tower/stack, bay, condition and effective consideration differences are unbounded for a target-price claim. No arbitrary PSF scaling, haircut or fixed sample requirement.
normalisation.substitution: Palma and Pelangi are buyer-task alternatives, not automatically interchangeable valuation comparables. Same-size interproject price differences do not identify management causality.
normalisation.temporal_limit: Cross-sectional records are not repeat sales; visible older/newer overlap does not prove a project-wide flat or falling index.
